I saw Danny Brown in concert. Well, I tried to, that is. He was listed as the only act that was going to play. We showed up right as the show was supposed to begin but there was only the DJ on stage playing music. Fine, that happens. Sometimes rappers show up late. I mean, I show up late almost everywhere, I get it. Fast forward an hour and a half, still no Danny Brown.

Then, the local acts come on stage. I had no idea there was supposed to be OTHER people there. They weren't listed. And this venue always lists if theres going to be other acts, even if they suck and are local. If they play, they get listed. So, for the next 1.5 hours, three of the most mediocre filler acts play. One got boo'd off stage, it was so bad. All of this was going on while one of the managers was coming out every 15 mins saying, "Are you guys ready for Danny Brown!?!" It was clear something was going on.

So, a little over 3 hours after he was supposed to start playing, the stage clears, everything quiets down. And he comes out... looking like shit. Like he's either rolling wayyy too hard or fucked up bad on something. Sweating before he even got on stage. Danny then proceeds to play three songs, well, parts of three songs and... leaves. That was it.

I have never seen a crowd more pissed before.

However, I found out a few weeks later that he was performing during a time in his life where he was really bad in to prescriptions and apologized greatly on Twitter to all his fans about how he felt bad about how he treated his shows. And I felt for him. Being an addict is a really shitty thing and makes you a different person. But it was still one of the most disappointing concerts of my life because he was one of my favorite rappers and my girlfriend's absolute favorite rapper. And all we got was pushed around by an angry mob and my ears bleed from the poor sound quality of the venue.

Oh, and to top it off, the venue editted their website to show the other rappers as part of the act the next morning. Fuck them.
